title: Exact global sections on an affine scheme with closed separably closed points
statement: Let T be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum], every point of which is closed and has separably closed residue field [def-pc-separably-closed]. Then the global-sections functor on abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] preserves finite colimits.

source.place: Tag 09AY, step 4 of the corrected Tag 0EZV argument

proof.text: The acyclicity theorem gives H^1(T,F)=Ext^1(Z_T,F)=0 for every F. The Ext criterion makes the constant integer sheaf projective. Its preadditive coyoneda functor preserves finite colimits. The constant-sheaf/global-sections adjunction and evaluation at 1 identify that functor with global sections. Transport colimit preservation across the natural isomorphism.
